{"test_name":"Ledger_2297_Objection3","test_code":"// Copyright (c) All contributors. All rights reserved.\n// Licensed under the MIT license. See LICENSE file in the project root for full license information.\n\n#nullable enable\n\nusing System;\nusing System.Collections.Generic;\nusing System.IO;\nusing System.Linq;\nusing System.Threading;\nusing System.Threading.Tasks;\nusing MessagePack.SourceGenerator;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Emit;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Testing;\n\npublic class Ledger_2297_Objection3\n{\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task NestedCompositeResolver_HasExcludeFromCodeCoverageOnResolverAndFormatterCache_AndCompiles()\n    {\n        var frameworkRefs = await ReferenceAssemblies.Net.Net80.ResolveAsync(\n            LanguageNames.CSharp,\n            CancellationToken.None);\n        var msgPackRefs = ReferencesHelper.GetReferences(ReferencesSet.MessagePack);\n        var references = new List<MetadataReference>(frameworkRefs);\n        references.AddRange(msgPackRefs);\n\n        var parseOptions = new CSharpParseOptions(LanguageVersion.Latest);\n\n        var probeCompilation = CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            \"Probe\",\n            Array.Empty<SyntaxTree>(),\n            references,\n            new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary));\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol compositeAttrSymbol = FindCompositeResolverAttribute(probeCompilation);\n        string attrTypeName = compositeAttrSymbol.ToDisplayString(SymbolDisplayFormat.FullyQualifiedFormat);\n        string attrArgs = BuildCompositeResolverAttributeArguments(compositeAttrSymbol);\n\n        string source = $$\"\"\"\nusing MessagePack;\nusing MessagePack.Resolvers;\n\nnamespace TestNamespace\n{\n    [MessagePackObject]\n    public class SampleObject\n    {\n        [Key(0)]\n        public int Value { get; set; }\n    }\n\n    public partial class OuterClass\n    {\n        [{{attrTypeName}}{{attrArgs}}]\n        public partial class NestedInClassResolver\n        {\n        }\n    }\n\n    public partial struct OuterStruct\n    {\n        [{{attrTypeName}}{{attrArgs}}]\n        public partial class NestedInStructResolver\n        {\n        }\n\n        public partial class MiddleClass\n        {\n            [{{attrTypeName}}{{attrArgs}}]\n            internal partial class DeeplyNestedResolver\n            {\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\"\"\";\n\n        CSharpCompilation compilation = CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            \"TestAssembly\",\n            new[] { CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(source, parseOptions) },\n            references,\n            new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary));\n\n        GeneratorDriver driver = CSharpGeneratorDriver.Create(new MessagePackGenerator().AsSourceGenerator());\n        driver = driver.RunGeneratorsAndUpdateCompilation(\n            compilation,\n            out Compilation output,\n            out ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> generatorDiagnostics);\n\n        GeneratorDriverRunResult runResult = driver.GetRunResult();\n\n        Assert.All(runResult.Results, r => Assert.Null(r.Exception));\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(generatorDiagnostics, d => d.Severity >= DiagnosticSeverity.Warning);\n\n        ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> outputDiagnostics = output.GetDiagnostics();\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(outputDiagnostics, d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error);\n\n        using var peStream = new MemoryStream();\n        EmitResult emitResult = output.Emit(peStream);\n        Assert.True(\n            emitResult.Success,\n            string.Join(Environment.NewLine, emitResult.Diagnostics.Where(d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error)));\n\n        AssertNestedResolverHasExcludeFromCodeCoverage(\n            output,\n            \"TestNamespace.OuterClass+NestedInClassResolver\",\n            \"TestNamespace.OuterClass\");\n        AssertNestedResolverHasExcludeFromCodeCoverage(\n            output,\n            \"TestNamespace.OuterStruct+NestedInStructResolver\",\n            \"TestNamespace.OuterStruct\");\n        AssertNestedResolverHasExcludeFromCodeCoverage(\n            output,\n            \"TestNamespace.OuterStruct+MiddleClass+DeeplyNestedResolver\",\n            \"TestNamespace.OuterStruct+MiddleClass\");\n    }\n\n    private static INamedTypeSymbol FindCompositeResolverAttribute(Compilation compilation)\n    {\n        var stack = new Stack<INamespaceSymbol>();\n        stack.Push(compilation.GlobalNamespace);\n        while (stack.Count > 0)\n        {\n            INamespaceSymbol ns = stack.Pop();\n            foreach (INamedTypeSymbol type in ns.GetTypeMembers())\n            {\n                if (type.Name == \"CompositeResolverAttribute\" && InheritsFromAttribute(type))\n                {\n                    return type;\n                }\n            }\n\n            foreach (INamespaceSymbol childNs in ns.GetNamespaceMembers())\n            {\n                stack.Push(childNs);\n            }\n        }\n\n        throw new InvalidOperationException(\"Could not find CompositeResolverAttribute in MessagePack references.\");\n    }\n\n    private static bool InheritsFromAttribute(INamedTypeSymbol type)\n    {\n        INamedTypeSymbol? current = type.BaseType;\n        while (current is not null)\n        {\n            if (current.ToDisplayString() == \"System.Attribute\")\n            {\n                return true;\n            }\n\n            current = current.BaseType;\n        }\n\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    private static string BuildCompositeResolverAttributeArguments(INamedTypeSymbol attrSymbol)\n    {\n        foreach (IMethodSymbol ctor in attrSymbol.Constructors)\n        {\n            if (ctor.DeclaredAccessibility == Accessibility.Public &&\n                ctor.Parameters.Length == 1 &&\n                ctor.Parameters[0].Type is IArrayTypeSymbol)\n            {\n                return \"(new global::System.Type[] { typeof(global::MessagePack.Resolvers.StandardResolver) })\";\n            }\n        }\n\n        foreach (IMethodSymbol ctor in attrSymbol.Constructors)\n        {\n            if (ctor.DeclaredAccessibility == Accessibility.Public &&\n                (ctor.Parameters.Length == 0 || ctor.Parameters.All(p => p.IsOptional)))\n            {\n                return \"()\";\n            }\n        }\n\n        throw new InvalidOperationException(\"Unsupported CompositeResolverAttribute constructor signature.\");\n    }\n\n    private static void AssertNestedResolverHasExcludeFromCodeCoverage(\n        Compilation compilation,\n        string resolverMetadataName,\n        string outerMetadataName)\n    {\n        INamedTypeSymbol? resolverSymbol = compilation.GetTypeByMetadataName(resolverMetadataName);\n        Assert.NotNull(resolverSymbol);\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol? outerSymbol = compilation.GetTypeByMetadataName(outerMetadataName);\n        Assert.NotNull(outerSymbol);\n\n        Assert.False(\n            HasExcludeFromCodeCoverage(outerSymbol!),\n            $\"Outer type '{outerMetadataName}' should not have ExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute.\");\n\n        Assert.True(\n            HasExcludeFromCodeCoverage(resolverSymbol!),\n            $\"Nested resolver '{resolverMetadataName}' is missing ExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute.\");\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol? formatterCacheSymbol = resolverSymbol!.GetTypeMembers(\"FormatterCache\", 1).SingleOrDefault();\n        Assert.NotNull(formatterCacheSymbol);\n\n        Assert.True(\n            HasExcludeFromCodeCoverage(formatterCacheSymbol!),\n            $\"Nested FormatterCache<T> inside '{resolverMetadataName}' is missing ExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute.\");\n    }\n\n    private static bool HasExcludeFromCodeCoverage(ISymbol symbol)\n    {\n        return symbol.GetAttributes().Any(a =>\n            a.AttributeClass?.ToDisplayString() == \"System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.ExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute\");\n    }\n}\n"}
